rules.description: Helmet evidence is visible for the worker/head region.
Worker/head region is missing helmet evidence in an active work area.
rules.recommended_action: Supervisor should verify helmet compliance in active work area.

rules.description: Worker/head region is missing helmet evidence inside a restricted zone.
rules.recommended_action: Trigger critical alert and verify restricted-zone access immediately.

rules.description: Worker/head region is missing helmet evidence in a work-at-height zone.
rules.recommended_action: Trigger critical alert and verify work-at-height PPE immediately.

rules.description: No-helmet cue occurs in an exempt zone.
rules.recommended_action: No alert; worker/head region is outside an active PPE-controlled work zone.

rules.description: Helmet evidence is uncertain in a PPE-controlled zone.
rules.recommended_action: Escalate to human review before sending an alert.

rules.description: Helmet evidence is uncertain in an exempt or low-risk zone.
rules.recommended_action: Retain for review without sending a safety alert.

rules.description: No-helmet cue has no reliable zone grounding.
rules.recommended_action: Escalate to human review because zone grounding is unavailable.

rules.description: No configured helmet-zone rule applies to the normalized evidence.
rules.recommended_action: No action; retain the no-match reason for audit.
